subFields.name: Minimum Purchased
subFields.description: Specify the minimum number of times a product must be purchased within the Time Period for this messaging to be displayed. If the product has been purchased fewer times, carted then browsed data will be reviewed before issuing fallback messaging (if enabled)

subFields.name: Display Number
subFields.description: Enable/Disable the display of number of items

subFields.name: Text
subFields.description: Specify the text to follow the number purchased e.g. for "4 purchased in last 24 hours" type 'purchased in last 24 hours' into the box. If you are based in the UK, make sure you comply with guidance from the CMA.

subFields.name: Colors
subFields.description: Set the text and background color for the Purchased Messaging

subFields.description: Bold the Purchased Messaging

subFields.name: Italics

subFields.name: Minimum Carted
subFields.description: Specify the minimum number of times a product must be carted within the Time Period for this messaging to be displayed. If the product has been carted fewer times, browsed data will be reviewed before issuing fallback messaging (if enabled)

subFields.name: Display Number
subFields.description: Enable/Disable the display of number of items

subFields.name: Text
subFields.description: Specify the text to follow the number carted e.g. for "4 carted in last 24 hours" type 'carted in last 24 hours' into the box. If you are based in the UK, make sure you comply with guidance from the CMA.

subFields.name: Display Number
subFields.description: Enable/Disable the display of number of items

subFields.name: Text
subFields.description: Specify the text to follow the number browsed e.g. for "4 browsed in last 24 hours" type 'browsed in last 24 hours' into the box. If you are based in the UK, make sure you comply with guidance from the CMA.

fields.name: Fallback
fields.description: Enable / Disable Fallback Messaging. If enabled this will only display if no Purchased / Carted / Browsed messaging is applicable based on the thresholds set above
